name: smwgraphics-duke-nukem-3d-menu-font
title: Duke Nukem 3D - Menu Font
description:
This is the pixel font originally used for menus in Duke Nukem 3D. Originally a 16x12 font, I've adapted it to be 16x16 and usable in levels as a title screen or cutscene font.

This font is a full A-Z, 0-9 set in one graphics file with minimal punctuation. Uses one palette row and the colours are laid out in a gradient for easy changing. See the sample level for details.
